sloka: न रावणसहस्रं मे युद्धे प्रतिबलं भवेत् ।शिलाभिस्तु प्रहरतः पादपैश्च सहस्रशः ।। ५.४३.१०।।।।
transliteration: na rāvaṇasahasraṁ me yuddhe pratibalaṁ bhavet ।śilābhistu praharataḥ pādapaiśca sahasraśaḥ ।। 5.43.10।।।।

translations.english: 'I am the son of the Windgod, destroyer of enemy army. I am a servant of Rama, the king of Kosala who can accomplish any task with ease.
